results.title: Prange 2 - Man ist ja jetzt Paar
results.original_title: Prange 2 - Man ist ja jetzt Paar
results.overview: Half a year has passed since Ralf Prange confessed his love to the woman of his dreams, Dörte, on New Year’s Eve. Now everyday life is setting in, and Prange feels like he’s losing control on all fronts. But Prange’s spirit of resistance has been awakened. With the help of his neighbor Horst, he hatches plans that are bound to lead to disaster...

results.title: Awkwardness
results.overview: In just a few seconds, it can be an awkwardness between two people who avoid facing each other.

results.title: Albe su la mont
results.original_title: Albe su la mont - Alba sulla montagna
results.overview: In an isolated mountain shack the paths of three unnamed men collide. As the tension brews, a fickle, capricious and thoroughly alive Mountain asserts itself as the ultimate force over their fates.

results.title: Particles of Dust
results.overview: The corpse of a young man shows up at the shores of Atalante marking the return of Isidore to the territory of the living. But coming back from the dead is a delicate affair. As he follows the traces of his past lives in search of lost memories and the promise of a story, Isidore finds himself caught in a deceitful web of narratives within narratives, a world of Time Travelers and Doppelgängers, Picture Eaters and Textile Merchants, Phantom Friends and Phantom Lovers.

results.title: Follow You There - A War Bride Story
results.original_title: Follow You There - A War Bride Story
results.overview: Andrew Rodgers is a professional musician from St. John's, NL. As a songwriter, he is always on the hunt for new and interesting stories to write about. After discovering a remarkable story in his own family, Andrew travels to Fair Haven, NL to talk to his Great Grandmother, Joan Masters, who is a war bride originally from the London area of Great Britain. She lived through WWII, met Andrew's Great Grandfather, Sam Masters, during his service in WWII, and together they travelled back to Sam's hometown of Fair Haven, NL to begin a new life after the war.

results.title: Mysteries of Our Summer
results.overview: A team of filmmakers travels around Lithuania’s summer festivals – from Midsummer’s Day and Assumption Day to the first day of September, which marks the end of summer – capturing short, playful moments of their journey on 16 mm film. By asking people they meet about miracles, faith, childhood, and memories, the filmmakers unexpectedly reveal hidden stories and sensitive confessions.

results.title: Astrodude: A SolarBalls Movie
results.overview: An older, future version of Astrodude's son travels back or intervenes to try and stop Astrodude from going missing on his next major space mission.

results.title: Twisted Tie: The Movie
results.overview: An intoxicating office romance begins when Kang Do-jin, a perfectionist team leader at a VVIP spatial design agency, and Lee Sun-woo, a rookie who admires him, cross the line during a rainy night shift. Do-jin tries to control Sun-woo through secret "hands-on tutoring," but their dynamic shifts when sly client manager Baek Yi-geon intervenes, stirring intense jealousy and possessiveness between them.

results.title: IRL (In Real Life)
results.overview: Two friends, a domestic worker and a beautician, log into the BGMI combat game daily where they slip briefly out of their real lives. Through their avatars, they explore different selves, anonymity and intimacy inside the virtual world of the game, as the battlefield becomes as much about companionship and transgression, as it is about thrill. The docu-fiction explores how players reimagine their bodies and construct personas, revealing a landscape of desire and performance.

results.title: The Beast in Me
results.overview: A man has something to hide from his date.
